title: The New Bag
content:
Mia loves social media. She often posts photos of her clothes and accessories.

One morning, she buys a new bag.

— Look at this! — Mia says to her friend, Anna.

— Wow! That is a beautiful bag!

Mia takes a photo and posts it online.

— Are these your new shoes too? — Anna asks.

— Yes! And look at those sunglasses!

A few minutes later, Mia checks her phone.

— Look! My post has many likes!

— That's great! — Anna says.

Mia smiles and puts her phone in this new bag.

— Now I'm ready for my day!
